milestones.title: Tool registry: contracts + strict schemas
definitionOfDone: Single tool registry metadata is the source of truth (names, args schema, endpoint mapping)
Execute validator + composer planner consume the same registry (no duplicated tool-name lists)
Arguments validated strictly per tool; response envelope consistent across tools
risks: Schema mismatch with underlying API routes

statusHistory.note: Implemented shared tool registry for tool names, args, endpoint plan mapping, and default args.

milestones.title: Execute dispatcher: secure + resilient
definitionOfDone: Harden /api/assistant/execute error handling (fetch + non-JSON decode + timeouts) with structured 502/504 responses
approvalToken enforced for execution; no unsafe query pass-through
Legacy payload compatibility kept; requestId/tool trace included in response meta

statusHistory.note: Hardened execute route with timeout, requestId/trace metadata, and structured network/abort/non-JSON error handling.

milestones.title: Assistant orchestration mode metadata
definitionOfDone: Assistant request supports executionMode (chat vs agent)
Assistant response meta includes orchestrationMode; visible in logs and stability reports
Planner/policy can consume conversation context safely without leaking secrets
risks: Mixed metrics between chat and agent flows

statusHistory.note: Routing stability suite passed in stable-all run (3/3 rounds, no flakes) with in-container base URL override to 127.0.0.1:3000.

milestones.title: Composer workflow integration (plan -> approve -> execute)
definitionOfDone: Prompt -> plan preview -> approval token -> execute -> result works end-to-end
UI surfaces tool trace (usedTools/citations) and handles execution errors cleanly

statusHistory.note: Composer E2E in Docker app container passed (plan, approval token, execute, invalid JSON validation). End-to-end flow verified on running environment without restarting Node.

milestones.title: Reliability hardening (rate limit, retries, budgets)
definitionOfDone: Define tool budgets (timeouts, retries, per-turn tool cap) and enforce consistently
Distributed rate-limit plan approved; tool-call alerts defined
Retry/circuit policy documented + implemented for transient failures

statusHistory.note: Implemented per-turn tool budget and transient-failure circuit policy in grounding runtime; added reliability policy doc and validated eval:assistant:perf-reliability:stable PASS (3/3 rounds) in Docker app container.

Added runtime enforcement in src/lib/assistant/tools.ts: ASSISTANT_TOOL_MAX_CALLS_PER_TURN budget, transient-failure circuit threshold, and alertable logs (tool_budget_enforced, transient_circuit_open). Added policy doc docs/ASSISTANT_TOOL_RELIABILITY_POLICY_V1.md. Validation passed: tsc, test:agent:contract, eval:assistant:perf-reliability:stable, eval:assistant:routing:stable (all Docker).

Reliability hardening completed: enforced per-turn tool budget and transient-failure circuit in grounding runtime, wired guard metrics into routing report/governance monitor thresholds, documented distributed rate-limit + alert policy, and validated via tsc + test:agent:contract + eval:assistant:routing.

milestones.title: Eval + release gates (stable and automated)
definitionOfDone: CI/PR gate runs merge + integration + assistant stability suites with artifacts
Stability gate all suites passes (routing, realworld, pr-gate, policy-matrix, perf, postcheck-anomaly)
Composer E2E smoke exists (plan -> approve -> execute -> result) and is runnable in Docker with a reused dev server

statusHistory.note: Full stability gate passed in Docker app container with in-container base URL override (ASSISTANT_EVAL_BASE_URL/SMOKE_BASE_URL=127.0.0.1:3000); routing, realworld, pr-gate, policy-matrix, perf-reliability, postcheck-anomaly all PASS.

milestones.title: Numeric fidelity expansion (beyond backtest)
definitionOfDone: Add tolerance-based numeric fidelity checks for risk, valuation, and fundamentals tool chains
Add citation payload sanity checks (tool/endpoint pairing and required fragments)
Add baseline metrics to stability report (track drift before hard failures)
risks: Overfitting eval thresholds to a narrow question bank
Provider variance causes noisy flakes without deterministic fallbacks

statusHistory.note: Implemented AGT-06 code changes: expanded numeric fidelity to risk/valuation/fundamentals, added citation sanity checks in routing/postcheck, and added drift baseline metrics in stability/baseline scripts. Validation passed for tsc + agent contract tests + postcheck lint + drift baseline; runtime eval pending due Docker daemon access denied in this session.

Completed AGT-06 in worktree runtime: added tolerance-based numeric fidelity checks for risk/valuation/fundamentals in comprehensive eval, added citation payload sanity checks (tool-endpoint pairing + fragment evidence) in routing/postcheck eval, and added drift baseline metrics to stability reports. Verified with runtime commands on Docker app: eval:assistant:routing PASS, eval:assistant:postcheck:v1 PASS, eval:assistant:full (ASSISTANT_EVAL_PROFILE=quick) PASS, and stability-gate routing report includes driftBaselines.
